newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada injects C$3.25 mln into Fleet.
newsitem.headline: Canada injects C$3.25 mln into Fleet.

text.p: Canadian industry ministry said on Monday that it is investing C$3.25 million in Fleet Industries Corp to support an 11-year project to design and build aircraft wing components.

The investment, which is repayable, will allow Fleet to enter into a contract with Hyundai Aerospace Ltd of South Korea for the design and production of McDonnell Douglas MD-95 aircraft wing components.
"This project is an important one both for Fleet and for the Canadian aerospace industry," said Member of Parliament John Maloney, whose Erie riding in southern Ontario is home to Fleet's facility.
Fleet is a division of Magellan Aerospace Corp.

The investment is expected to support up to 82 jobs. The money is part of the Canadian government's Technology Partnerships Canada program desigend to promote technological development and job creation.
